name: Elf grove
description: Green and black Elves that make mana, fill the board with Elf tokens, make each other stronger and keep you drawing cards.

cards.name: Vaerith Nightbloom
cards.rule_text:
Whenever another Elf you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, if three or more Elves you control entered this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: She plants her seeds at night, and the grove wakes up larger.

cards.name: Ildrin, Keeper of the Root-Library
cards.rule_text:
Other Elves you control have "{T}: Add {G}."
{3}, {T}: Draw a card. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each other Elf you control.

cards.name: Banner-Warden of the Oldwood
cards.rule_text:
Other Elves you control get +1/+1.
{1}{G}, {T}: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
cards.flavor_text: Where her banner flies, the forest answers.

cards.name: Dewgather Initiate
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
When CARDNAME enters, if you control another Elf, scry 1.
cards.flavor_text: Every morning she gathers the dew, and every morning the grove grows.

cards.name: Gloomroot Stalker
cards.rule_text:
Deathtouch
When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.

cards.name: Leafshadow Bowyer
cards.rule_text:
Reach
When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.

cards.name: Grovecant Seer
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Elf card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Mirewood Mourner
cards.rule_text: Whenever another Elf you control dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.flavor_text: She weeps for every fallen kinsman, and remembers what each one knew.

cards.name: Hollowbark Ranger
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Duskleaf Blademaster
cards.rule_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking.

cards.name: Gloomvine Hexer
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Elves you control.

cards.name: Mother of the Thornhollow
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens. Then if you control seven or more Elves, draw two cards.

cards.name: Highcrown Treesinger
cards.rule_text:
Trample
Other Elves you control have trample.
When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each Elf you control.
cards.flavor_text: When she sings, the oldest trees bend to listen.

cards.name: Sound the Leafhorn
cards.rule_text: Create three 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens. Then if you control five or more Elves, put a +1/+1 counter on each Elf you control.

cards.name: Counsel of the Ring-Trees
cards.rule_text: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of Elves you control. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Venom from the Roots
cards.rule_text: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If you control three or more Elves, that creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn instead.

cards.name: Blight of the Deep Wood
cards.rule_text: All non-Elf creatures get -3/-3 until end of turn.
cards.flavor_text: The grove keeps its own. Everything else rots.

cards.name: Moonleaf Gathering
cards.rule_text: Whenever one or more Elves you control enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Heartseed of the First Tree
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {B} or {G}.
{4}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw two cards.

cards.name: Glade of the Elder Boughs
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped unless you control an Elf.
{T}: Add {B} or {G}.
